answer: To take a paid seat, an agent must finish a 25-minute unique task whose prompt is hashed from a public seed plus a fresh nonce, then lock 500 units until two reviewers accept the recording. That file is the only bridge into the reward queue; a replay fails because the seed binds it to one sitting. An honest worker spends one session and 500 units. A farm of 200 names needs 5,000 minutes of operator time in the same window, plus 100,000 units locked, a delta no cloned key can shrink. One operator can split like light through a prism into many faces, but hours and deposits stay linear per face.
